vulnerability_type: Incorrect Token Unit Conversion in Mint/Burn

preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call mint() function
Attacker needs existing token balance to exploit burn() function

exploit_hint: The mint() and burn() functions do not properly convert between reflection (_rOwned) and token (_tOwned) amounts. Call mint() with a large amount as owner - this adds the amount directly to both _tTotal and _rOwned without applying the reflection rate conversion (_getRate()). This creates an imbalance where the attacker receives more reflection value than intended. After minting, transfer tokens to realize the economic gain. Alternatively, call burn() to manipulate the _rTotal/_tTotal ratio, then mint or transfer to exploit the skewed rate. The key is that reflection tokens should be converted using currentRate = _rTotal/_tTotal, but these functions bypass this conversion.
